question: Should autoreview make the proposed Codex/Claude model, effort, refusal-fallback, and provider-authentication choices shared defaults for existing users?
rationale: The patch establishes model-selection, cost, fallback, and credential-routing policy rather than making only a mechanical isolation repair.

options.title: Keep compatibility defaults
options.body: Preserve existing behavior by default and expose the panel, Opus fallback, and provider routing through explicit flags or environment configuration with upgrade proof.

options.title: Adopt new defaults
options.body: Make the proposed model, effort, retry, fallback, and authentication policy shared defaults after live-provider evidence documents the upgrade impact.

options.title: Narrow to isolation only
options.body: Land only credential-isolation hardening and defer persistent panel defaults and cross-model fallback to separately sponsored work.

recommendation.title: Keep compatibility defaults
recommendation.body: Preserve existing behavior by default and expose the panel, Opus fallback, and provider routing through explicit flags or environment configuration with upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects steipete to the existing autoreview defaults, isolation contract, credential hardening, and validation workflow.
